I am 100% sure there is no better place for your pet's health than this, and I know this because for over 14 years they cared for our dog with so much love and compassion. Barbie is no longer with us; since Friday night she has been resting peacefully with God. And I take this opportunity to say
thank you very much, on behalf of my entire family, to Doctors Luis and Maria and their whole team for everything they always did for her. Thank you.
The Staff and the doctor are always super friendly and understanding. Thanks  guys

We’ve been bringing our pets here for some time and trust them to provide the best care. Overall, we’ve been very happy with the service and feel confident leaving our pets in their hands. The only concern is that the initial quote we receive often ends up being 30% or more higher at checkout because something was not included in the original estimate. It would be helpful if all services and charges could be clearly included in the initial quote to avoid unexpected costs.
Excellent customer service. Dr  Luis Alvarez saved my dog's life without hesitation. Highly recommended.
Dr.Alvarez and his staff are amazing. If you’re looking for a Vet this is the place to go. Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful experience at Country Walk Animal Hospital. From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel welcome. The office was clean, the staff was friendly and we were seen very quickly. Dr. Luis Alvarez and the veterinary technician Hugo were courteous and professional. They took the time to explain everything clearly and genuinely cared for my dog Kodi. I highly recommend Country Walk Animal Hospital for compassionate, quality care. Thank you again!
I have been going to this vet for about 12 years. My first dog was 2 months old when we started going. I love how great they are with pets and how much you can see they love them.

The doctor and the staff are very good and professional, above all very compassionate.
I have taken my pet for 13 years and a half, almost 14 years and we are very happy, I would not change them for anything.
